description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware on different hardware boards. It includes functions to check the image and perform upgrades based on board type, with particular logic for NEC and EnGenius devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for specific U-Boot version strings on certain NEC boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures specific to particular EnGenius devices or defaults for other boards.
